desc:
After an icy dwarf planet shatters into rings above the earth, which soon fall down as asteroids, a worldwide flood of acidic water begins to rise, bringing on a climate catastrophe and the end of the world as we know it. As their houses are consumed by the killer flood to their horror, and islands disappear under the water, people flock to the tallest peaks and mountains around the globe in boats and airplanes to escape the rising waters for a chance at survival, the tallest of which being Mount Tyranny. Unfortunately for you, between you and mount tyranny is a massive area of flooded land with the highest density of natural disasters on the planet, giving it the nickname: DISASTER OCEAN.
Survive a tornado, tsunami, hurricane, or meteor shower in a boat, and try not to end up in a sinking ship!
Go to the dockmaster to spawn a ship.
The game is best experienced with a friend.

I created a new ship disaster survival game: https://www.roblox.com/games/115508583726985/Ocean-Disaster !!!
